server.name: athena
server.title: Athena powered by ALP, construction agents

tools.name: onboarding
tools.title: Company profile and members
tools.description: Read or save the company profile Athena works for (role, work types, trades, tool stack, decision rights, default applicability), and add members as Owner, PM or All-access. Athena is for contractors running their own construction company: never offer a consulting option or frame anything as consulting. No job number is needed here; it is required when you create a job.

action.description: read, save_company (create or update), add_member, or save_brand (SOV logo link and footer).

company_id.description: Only needed if you belong to more than one company. Pass the company name exactly as Athena lists it (e.g. "ALP Construction"); a company id also works. Not case-sensitive. If the member hasn't named one, call list_open_items with no job_number to list the companies.

your_name.description: Your display name on the company (when creating).

agent_name.description: What to call the agent. Default 'Athena PM'.

company_role.description: Company role, e.g. mechanical prime / specialty sub.

decision_rights.description: Who may approve each: roles (owner, pm, all_access) or member names.

logo_url.description: save_brand: https link to the company logo (PNG, JPG or SVG). Leave out if there is none; the company name prints in bold.

license_number.description: save_brand: license designation and number as it should print on the SOV footer.

contact_name.description: save_brand: named contact on the SOV footer.

website.description: save_brand: website printed in the SOV footer (plain text).

tools.name: intake
tools.title: Job setup intake
tools.description: Create a job (keyed by job number) and record its setup: job settings (time zone, PM), step 0 scoping, contract terms, contract deadlines, estimate handoff, budget and SOV, open items, a delay event, or a two-week lookahead. Missing data is recorded as unknown, never guessed. Record every delay, slip or schedule impact the member mentions with section delay_event before answering.

section.description: Which part of setup to record. Use clauses for contract notice and time clauses, copied word for word.

company_id.description: Only needed if you belong to more than one company. Pass the company name exactly as Athena lists it (e.g. "ALP Construction"); a company id also works. Not case-sensitive. If the member hasn't named one, call list_open_items with no job_number to list the companies.

restrict_to.description: create_job: member names who may see this job (leave out for all members).

time_zone.description: job_settings: IANA time zone, e.g. America/Chicago. Deadlines are computed in it.

pm.description: job_settings: the job PM's name only (put the email in pm_email; no notes such as "non-member"). A company member is linked; anyone else is saved as a contact (name + email) with no Athena access.

pm_email.description: job_settings: the PM's email. Used as the suggested From on drafts. No Athena access is granted.

pm_title.description: job_settings: the PM's title for draft signatures. Default 'Project Manager'.

delay_description.description: delay_event: what slipped, in the member's words, e.g. 'Lighting rough-in slipped 3 weeks'.

delay_activity.description: delay_event: the schedule activity affected, if named.

delay_start_date.description: delay_event: the date the delay began. Leave out if the member doesn't know; Athena flags both notices due today with 'confirm start date'.

delay_days.description: delay_event: estimated impact in calendar days, if stated.

delay_cause.description: delay_event: cause, if stated. Never guess it.

clauses.description: clauses: Contract clauses: pass each clause's text exactly as written in the contract (copy it, never summarize, shorten or merge), one clause per entry with its section number and heading, and pass the full contract text as contract_text so Athena can verify it. If a clause isn't in the contract, leave it out; Athena opens an item to confirm it.

heading.description: The clause heading as printed, e.g. Delay Notice. Leave out if the clause has none.

text.description: The clause text copied exactly as written in the contract. Never summarize, shorten or merge clauses.

category.description: Optional; Athena classifies from the heading and text when left out.

contract_text.description: clauses: the full contract text as uploaded (copied, not summarized). Used to verify each clause word for word; stored with the job, readable by members with contract access.

label.description: deadline: what is due, e.g. 'Delay notice: utility shutdown denied'.

trigger_desc.description: deadline: the event that starts the clock.

trigger_date.description: deadline: date of the triggering event.

trigger_alternatives.description: deadline: other plausible trigger dates if the trigger is ambiguous.

n_days.description: deadline: number of days in the clause.

day_type.description: deadline: only if the contract defines it. Leave out otherwise.

holidays.description: deadline: holidays listed in the contract. Leave out otherwise.

weekend_roll.description: deadline: true only if the contract moves weekend/holiday deadlines later.

fixed_date.description: deadline: a fixed contract date (e.g. substantial completion).

delivery_method.description: deadline / open_item: how it must be sent, per the contract.

recipient.description: deadline / open_item: who it must go to.

item_type.description: open_item: type. na_disposition is applied automatically under N/A sections.

waiting_on_who.description: open_item pending_document: who it is coming from.

clause_source.description: open_item deadline: clause or source of the due date.

use_defaults.description: scope: true when the member says 'use the defaults' (or similar). Athena fills job type, sector and position from the company profile where it can, leaves everything else (e.g. client type, pricing model) unconfirmed, saves and moves on. Fields you also send win.

key_clauses.description: scope: which key clauses the job has.

contract_document_provided.description: contract/deadline/warranty: true ONLY if you read these terms from the contract document itself in this conversation (and give contract_document_name). Terms the member typed or told you are manual: leave this out.

contract_document_name.description: contract/deadline/warranty: the contract document the terms were read from (file name or title). Required for source document; without it the terms are saved as manual.

notice_timing.description: contract: notice deadline and clause, as written

workmanship_warranty.description: warranty: is there a workmanship warranty?

workmanship_warranty_months.description: warranty: how long the workmanship warranty runs, in months.

warranty_start_trigger.description: warranty: what starts the workmanship warranty. Owner acceptance = final_acceptance. Prefer warranty_start_trigger_text with the member's own words.

warranty_start_trigger_text.description: warranty: the member's own words for what starts the warranty (e.g. "owner acceptance"). Mapped for you and wins over warranty_start_trigger.

warranty_start_trigger_other.description: warranty: describe the trigger when warranty_start_trigger is other

warranty_trigger_date.description: warranty: the actual date of the trigger event, once it has happened. Leave out until then.

warranty_start_basis.description: warranty: what sets the warranty start date (clause or document)

closeout_documents.description: warranty: required closeout documents (O&Ms, as-builts, etc.); "unknown" if not known

punch_final_acceptance.description: warranty: punch list and final acceptance requirements

manufacturer_warranties.description: warranty: manufacturer warranties to collect, or none

closeout_expectations.description: warranty: other closeout expectations (training, commissioning, final cleaning, lien waivers, warranty walk, turnover meeting), or none

gaps.description: handoff: each gap becomes an open item with its named owner.

budget_lines.description: budget: internal cost budget by cost code (internal only).

sov_lines.description: budget: owner SOV lines at billable value, with the cost codes each maps to. For the SOV, number lines 01.01-style (CSI division, dot, line).

spec_section.description: Spec section number from the job's specs (e.g. 26 05 19). Only when the specs give one; never invent it.

fee_pct.description: budget: contractor's fee as a percent of the contract total (e.g. 15). The SOV adds this fee on top of the SOV lines, so give it only when the lines are cost of work + GC before fee. If the lines already add up to the contract sum (e.g. a lump-sum subcontract), give 0.

sov_basis.description: budget: the contract document the SOV numbers come from, e.g. "Schedule A, Total Investment".

lookahead_exists.description: lookahead: the member's answer to "is there a two-week look-ahead on this job?" Leave out the first time; Athena asks. yes = they have one, build = they want Athena to build it from the schedule, no = they don't (Athena pushes back).

schedule_export.description: lookahead: schedule export, as plain text. Leave out if you don't have it; it is recorded as unknown.

crews.description: lookahead: crews/subs by day, as plain text. Leave out if you don't have it; it is recorded as unknown.

submittal_log.description: lookahead: submittal log, as plain text. Leave out if you don't have it; it is recorded as unknown.

rfi_log.description: lookahead: RFI log, as plain text. Leave out if you don't have it; it is recorded as unknown.

inspection_list.description: lookahead: inspection list, as plain text. Leave out if you don't have it; it is recorded as unknown.

deliveries.description: lookahead: deliveries list, as plain text. Leave out if you don't have it; it is recorded as unknown.

tools.name: next_question
tools.title: Next question
tools.description: Get the next setup question for a job, one at a time (or the next lookahead question when lookahead_id is given). Skips anything marked N/A or already answered.

company_id.description: Only needed if you belong to more than one company. Pass the company name exactly as Athena lists it (e.g. "ALP Construction"); a company id also works. Not case-sensitive. If the member hasn't named one, call list_open_items with no job_number to list the companies.

lookahead_id.description: Only for a two-week lookahead. The lookahead ref as printed (e.g. LA-3F2A1) or its lookahead_id.

tools.name: answer
tools.title: Answer or mark N/A
tools.description: Answer the current question (yes / no / na / unknown), mark an item or section N/A, re-enable it, or decline a re-enable suggestion. N/A only stops future questions; it never closes open items. Unknown opens a confirm item.

company_id.description: Only needed if you belong to more than one company. Pass the company name exactly as Athena lists it (e.g. "ALP Construction"); a company id also works. Not case-sensitive. If the member hasn't named one, call list_open_items with no job_number to list the companies.

check_key.description: answer: the question ref shown by next_question (e.g. gate-role-gc) or check_key from structured content. mark_na/reenable with scope item: the same ref.

lookahead_help.description: answer on check bss_lookahead with response "no": "accept" if the member wants help building a look-ahead, "decline" if not (logs an open item). Leave out the first time; Athena asks.

detail.description: Details, or the N/A reason (max 10,000 characters).

owner.description: Accountable person for a follow-up. Leave out if unknown.

section.description: mark_na / reenable with scope section: section name, e.g. bid_documents, insurance_bonding, contract_time, self_perform_premob.

lookahead_id.description: Only for a two-week lookahead question. The lookahead ref as printed (e.g. LA-3F2A1) or its lookahead_id.

tools.name: report
tools.title: Job report
tools.description: Render the full job setup report (internal or client-facing), or the two-week lookahead report when lookahead_id is given. Client-facing reports leave out internal cost and strategy detail. To read back just the contract terms, use contract_terms instead. Contract clauses stay word for word; summaries only on request (include_summary true).

company_id.description: Only needed if you belong to more than one company. Pass the company name exactly as Athena lists it (e.g. "ALP Construction"); a company id also works. Not case-sensitive. If the member hasn't named one, call list_open_items with no job_number to list the companies.

lookahead_id.description: Only for a two-week lookahead report. The lookahead ref as printed (e.g. LA-3F2A1) or its lookahead_id.

deliverable.description: Default setup. sov: the schedule of values data and its layout recipe (full job access only; audience client for the copy sent to the owner).

sov_view.description: SOV only. Default lines: every SOV line item with its % of total. divisions: the division subtotal roll-up, only when the member asks for it.

include_summary.description: Setup report only. Default false: contract clauses word for word, then an offer to summarize. Set true only after the member asks for a plain-English summary.

tools.name: contract_terms
tools.title: Read contract terms
tools.description: Read back a job's contract clauses word for word with section numbers, missing clauses and the applicability flags (ON / OFF / UNKNOWN). Show the clauses word for word first, then offer: 'Do you want me to summarize this legal text so you know what it means in plain English?' Only if the member says yes, call again with include_summary true for the plain-language notice requirements and saved summary fields. Never paraphrase a clause in place of its text. Use this, not the setup report, when the member asks what terms are on file or to confirm terms they just entered. Read-only.

company_id.description: Only needed if you belong to more than one company. Pass the company name exactly as Athena lists it (e.g. "ALP Construction"); a company id also works. Not case-sensitive. If the member hasn't named one, call list_open_items with no job_number to list the companies.

include_summary.description: Default false: the clauses word for word only, then an offer to summarize. Set true only after the member asks for a plain-English summary.

tools.name: carry_forward
tools.title: Carry forward open items
tools.description: Move open items from last week's lookahead into this week's lookahead for the same job, with history.

company_id.description: Only needed if you belong to more than one company. Pass the company name exactly as Athena lists it (e.g. "ALP Construction"); a company id also works. Not case-sensitive. If the member hasn't named one, call list_open_items with no job_number to list the companies.

from_lookahead_id.description: Previous lookahead. The lookahead ref as printed (e.g. LA-3F2A1) or its lookahead_id.

to_lookahead_id.description: New lookahead from intake. The lookahead ref as printed (e.g. LA-3F2A1) or its lookahead_id.

tools.name: list_open_items
tools.title: List open items
tools.description: List a job's open items with accountable person, needed-by date, verified or last-reported status, source and effects. Items under an N/A section are labeled for disposition. If the member hasn't named a company or a job, call list_open_items with no job_number (and no company_id): Athena lists the companies and their jobs itself, so don't ask the member to guess.

job_number.description: Job number, exact match (e.g. 2417). Leave out when the member hasn't named a job: Athena then lists your companies and their jobs.

company_id.description: Only needed if you belong to more than one company. Pass the company name exactly as Athena lists it (e.g. "ALP Construction"); a company id also works. Not case-sensitive. If the member hasn't named one, call list_open_items with no job_number to list the companies.

lookahead_id.description: Limit to one lookahead. The lookahead ref as printed (e.g. LA-3F2A1) or its lookahead_id.

date_sweep.description: true only when the member asks for the date sweep (overdue, due today, next 14 days). It also shows on its own when a job is first opened in a session.

tools.name: resolve_item
tools.title: Resolve or update an open item
tools.description: Close an open item with evidence, close a confirm item with a dated statement, waive it (decision right and reason required), close a commercial item on approval + billing + collection, or record a last-reported status update. N/A is not a resolution.

company_id.description: Only needed if you belong to more than one company. Pass the company name exactly as Athena lists it (e.g. "ALP Construction"); a company id also works. Not case-sensitive. If the member hasn't named one, call list_open_items with no job_number to list the companies.

item_id.description: The item: the ref shown on its line in list_open_items (e.g. A1 or 36C31, with or without "Ref") or the item_id from structured content.

kind.description: How it is being closed or updated.

evidence.description: Evidence: a document (name or number), or for member_statement what was said. A bare "we're good" is not evidence; the item stays open.

stated_by.description: member_statement / update: who said it, only if the member named someone. Leave out and it is attributed to the calling user.

stated_on.description: member_statement / update: date of the statement.

tools.name: cpm_activities
tools.title: Full CPM activity list
tools.description: REQUIRED: call this before drawing or updating any cost-loaded CPM, billing forecast, billing drill-down, coaching, IOR or dashboard. Returns every saved activity on the job (ID, name, duration, start/finish, predecessors and logic, total float, critical flag, % complete, $ value, SOV line, cost code), the count check (e.g. 39 of 39), the tie to the contract, the ONE saved contract completion date and the computed delay (TIA) result. Use these values exactly; never recompute, rebuild from an earlier chat, or guess them. Owner-furnished activities are $0.00 in ALP billing. Supers get the schedule with no dollars.

company_id.description: Only needed if you belong to more than one company. Pass the company name exactly as Athena lists it.

version.description: A past CPM version to view; default the latest saved one.

tools.name: living_report_get
tools.title: Living report master copy
tools.description: REQUIRED: call this before updating a cost-loaded CPM, billing forecast, IOR or PM dashboard, and when a new chat picks one up. Returns the saved master copy (latest or a named version) with its version, last-updated stamp, data date, data and change log. Viewing: build a new private view from it and never change the saved master. Updating (only when the user explicitly asks, after confirming): update that copy in place; never start a second saved one. Supers: CPM only, no dollars.

company_id.description: Only needed if you belong to more than one company. Pass the company name exactly as Athena lists it.

report_type.description: cpm (cost-loaded CPM), billing_forecast, ior or dashboard.

version.description: A past version (for v6 vs v7 or a rollback view); default the latest.

tools.name: living_report_save
tools.title: Save living report version (after approval)
tools.description: REQUIRED: ask the PM first and call this only after they say yes to this exact update. Saves a new version of the job's cost-loaded CPM, billing forecast, IOR or PM dashboard as the master copy, with what changed and why. Athena refuses the save if any activity is dropped, an activity is undated, or (CPM and billing forecast) the total doesn't equal the contract to the cent. Owner-furnished work is $0.00 in ALP billing. Full job access only.

company_id.description: Only needed if you belong to more than one company. Pass the company name exactly as Athena lists it.

report_type.description: cpm (cost-loaded CPM), billing_forecast, ior or dashboard.

base_version.description: The version you loaded with living_report_get (0 for the first save).

approved.description: true only after the PM said yes to saving this exact update.

what_changed.description: One line: what changed since the last version.

activities.description: The FULL activity list (every activity, none dropped). Required for cpm.

owner_furnished.description: true for owner-furnished work (schedule-only, $0.00 in ALP billing).

billing.description: Billing forecast: every month, billed actuals and forecast. Months must total the contract.

tia.description: cpm: the delay fragnet analysis dates from the forward pass.

fragnet.description: The delay fragnet ID, e.g. FRAG-01.

fragnet_only_completion.description: Completion with only this delay fragnet inserted.

details.description: ior items or dashboard KPIs, as given.

contract_completion_date.description: cpm: the contract completion date. Saved once per job.

replace_completion_date.description: true only when the PM confirmed changing the saved contract completion date.

tools.name: file_share
tools.title: Share a file as a link
tools.description: Use this when an email needs a file you built (SOV, schedule or CPM PDF, report, notice, Excel or CSV) and your email tool can't attach it, or the member wants a link. Send the file's bytes as content_base64 (or, in ChatGPT, a chat file as file) with the job_number, kind and filename. Athena checks the file type (PDF, .xlsx, .docx, CSV or PNG, up to 10 MB), stores it privately for this job and returns a link anyone with it can open until it expires (30 days by default). Put the link in the email body; never say the file is attached unless your email tool attached it. Supers can share schedules only.

company_id.description: Only needed if you belong to more than one company. Pass the company name exactly as Athena lists it.

kind.description: sov, schedule (CPM or Gantt), report, notice or other.

filename.description: File name with its extension, e.g. 2701 SOV.pdf. Allowed: .pdf, .xlsx, .docx, .csv, .png.

content_base64.description: The file's bytes, base64 encoded (a data: prefix is fine). Required unless file is given.

file.description: ChatGPT only: a chat file reference. Use content_base64 everywhere else.

expires_in_days.description: Days the link works, default 30, at most 90.

tools.name: file_share_revoke
tools.title: Turn off a file link
tools.description: Turns off a file link Athena made, right away, and deletes the stored file. Call only after the member asks to turn off that link. Full job access, or the member who shared it.

company_id.description: Only needed if you belong to more than one company. Pass the company name exactly as Athena lists it.

tools.name: job_cadence
tools.title: Job cadence
tools.description: Read or save the job cadence after the CPM is built: weekly PM/OAC meeting, two-week lookahead day, daily update time, morning briefing time, pay app dates (pencil draft, cutoff, submission) and the schedule update cycle. Ask the six one at a time with the suggested default; save each answer as you go. When all six are set, show the Job cadence card and ask whether to set them up as reminders. Saving the cadence never creates reminders.

company_id.description: Only needed if you belong to more than one company. Pass the company name exactly as Athena lists it.

action.description: get: the saved cadence and the next question. save: record the answers given (any of the six).

pm_meeting.description: Weekly PM/OAC meeting day and time, e.g. Tue 10:00.

lookahead_day.description: Two-week lookahead day, e.g. Thu, issued to subs Fri.

daily_update_time.description: When daily updates are due from the field, e.g. 4:00 PM daily.

morning_briefing_time.description: Morning briefing time, e.g. 7:00 AM workdays.

pay_app_dates.description: Pay app pencil draft day, cutoff and submission day, from the contract.

update_cycle.description: Schedule update cycle, e.g. monthly, data date = pay app cutoff.

tools.name: job_cadence_reminders
tools.title: Set up job cadence reminders (after a yes)
tools.description: REQUIRED: ask the PM first and call this only after they say yes to setting up the cadence reminders. Creates one open-item reminder per saved cadence item on the job (already-open reminders are kept, not duplicated). Never call it on your own.

company_id.description: Only needed if you belong to more than one company. Pass the company name exactly as Athena lists it.

approved.description: true only after the PM said yes to setting up these reminders.

items.description: Only these cadence items; default all six that are saved.

tools.name: morning_briefing
tools.title: Morning briefing
tools.description: Read-only. Call once when the member says "good morning" (or "Athena, good morning", "morning briefing") or the daily check-in fires. Returns, scoped to the caller's role: today's top 3, overdue items and risks, today's lookahead activities, inspections and deliveries, RFIs and submittals, reminders with countdowns, and the field-update questions. Supers and field roles get no dollars; PMs get only their own jobs. Changes nothing.

job_number.description: One job; leave out for every job the member can see.
